name: cafe-qr-ordering-system
description: Production-ready QR table ordering with a live admin dashboard and menu editor for cafes and restaurants.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
